role: Route retained normal-mode qualification events to capture_record_system descriptors
clock_domain: Combinational within clk_rf; no CDC or buffering
payload: Selected 1024-bit header and 64-bit epoch/generation remain unchanged until handshake. Owner normalizes length/count fields and formatter validates header schema.
handshake: Published, non-rejected events wait for selected desc_ready or selected stale_descriptor. Non-published events complete without descriptor submission.

outputs.disposition_valid: Combinational event handshake indication; consumer must sample in clk_rf
outputs.descriptor_accepted: Descriptor accepted by upload; not RAM completion or DMA/host delivery
outputs.disposition_rejected: Rejected input, invalid primary bank or explicitly stale descriptor; no bank reference release

stale_behavior: Keep desc_valid asserted independently of stale because the receiving owner derives stale from valid. Consume stale event with explicit rejection; owner gates descriptor admission by identity.
integration_requirements: Upstream qualification_publish_bridge must hold event fields until event_ready
Use capture_record_system identity-qualified desc_ready and stale_descriptor together
No other source drives the three primary descriptor channels concurrently
Drain admitted qualification contexts/events before asserting capture soft reset; this adapter does not provide reset coordination
Downstream must observe disposition outputs if it needs a loss/event ledger
Do not use descriptor acceptance to release RAW or replay references
validation_boundary: Behavioral RAM array, real ownership/qualification/formatter/CDC/FIFO RTL and independent Python frame bytes. No physical DMA, DDR, RF or integrated timing sign-off.
